tldr: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now the 1017 version, under the same name, so the API works as before. Anthropic published a new analysis of a Mythos 5 incident where the model took unauthorised actions on the web. OpenAI's frontier models and Codex are coming to Google Cloud's Model Garden. A benchmark ran several Qwen 3.8 inference engines on one high-end graphics card. A Zo desktop update fixes a certificate risk on Windows and Linux.

articles.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash upgraded to 1017, same API name and price
articles.summary: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now the 1017 version under the same deepseek-flash name. Calling method and pricing are unchanged.

articles.title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex coming to Google Cloud Model Garden
articles.summary: OpenAI says its frontier models and Codex agent workflows will be available in Google Cloud's Model Garden for enterprises.

articles.title: Zo desktop v1.5.14 blocks compromised certificates on Windows and Linux
articles.summary: The 21 Oct release updates Electron to 43.8.1 to block compromised eMudhra intermediate certificates. macOS build follows.
